# Dihedral-orbit idea: in each demo, how many clean windows share the same dihedral orbit as the true source tile?
def diheds(a):
    res=[]; cur=a.copy(); seen=set()
    for k in range(4):
        for v in (cur, cur[:,::-1]):
            t=tuple(map(tuple,v.tolist()))
            if t not in seen:
                seen.add(t); res.append(v)
        cur=np.rot90(cur)
